steps: Verify the recorded file-byte hashes first. Decode the prepared source and captured candidate_family from acceptance-report.room_solver.global_diagnostics. Recompute their canonical hashes. For every shape verify its ordered index and SHA over width,height,rooms,containers, excluding index and sha256.

Using actual integer-grid coordinates, reconstruct exact closed translation segments for each required root pair. Test right,left,above,below root contacts. A side is valid only if every named room pair reaches the corresponding exterior faces and has at least24 grid units of shared boundary. Intersect every contact's offset interval with root containment in boundary1528x425. Use no solver response or persisted support count as a geometry witness.

For each half join clean/staff and staff/support rows on the exact staff shape index. Reject triples whose clean/support X intervals overlap: their heights260-or268 plus201 exceed425. Opposite-side neighbors exclude either building-X facade for the office. Test each source office's available bottom/top facade, fixing staffY to0 or425-staffHeight. Intersect clean/support Y intervals with their absolute boundary domains.

Join each remaining triple with the two simultaneous logistics/clean contacts raw_storage/material_airlock and finished_storage/packaging. Reject empty absolute logisticsY domains. Both halves have exactly96 necessary surviving cases and only staff52/53. Remove duplicate support/facade variants to obtain48 distinct (clean,staff,logistics) options per half. For the subsequent contradiction drop remaining support and Y restrictions, making a weaker necessary problem.

Every remaining staff height is328 and every clean height is260 or268. Any pair among these four roots has combined height greater than425, so all must be disjoint in X. Each clean/staff contact forms a contiguous X block. For each of the48x48 option pairs join every exact receiving-bridge support matching both logistics indices. Keep separate support rows even if they share an X interval; there are1664 joins.

Let A/B block X intervals relative to their clean origins be [LA,RA] and [LB,RB], logistics-minus-clean offsets [oAlo,oAhi]/[oBlo,oBhi], and bridge logisticsB-minus-logisticsA X interval [dxlo,dxhi]. Allowed clean-origin delta is [dxlo+oAlo-oBhi,dxhi+oAhi-oBlo]. Disjoint blocks require delta<=LA-RB or delta>=RA-LB. Every allowed interval lies strictly inside that excluded gap. Record min(allowedLow-(LA-RB),(RA-LB)-allowedHigh); the minimum across all1664 rows is16 grid units.

Rebuild the concrete80-room witness from the exact selected shape indices/origins below, multiplying all grid coordinates by100mm and translating both actual rooms and child containers. The previously executed fresh validate_zone_layout with recursive_zones=True/minimum_adjacency_mm=2400 reports exactly one required_adjacency issue for A/receiving-B/receiving, shared boundary0mm. Preserve the original entry and all original source requirements.

For local append examples only, copy original room declarations and internal relations into each local boundary, preserve original per-axis minimums/areas and child containers, and check actual rectangles. Retain declared equipment. Check individual room_fit_dimensions options including wall thickness, explicitly separating individual fits from mutual equipment packing. Compute support inventories for an appended candidate without claiming full augmented-family feasibility.
